changes.before: Pakiusap. Bubuksan ko ba at titingnan ang takip bago tanggapin?
changes.after: Pakiusap. Maaari ko bang buksan ang takip ng bago at tingnan ito bago tanggapin?
changes.reason: Japanese requests permission to inspect before acceptance, rather than asking whether to do so.
